distractorWhy: Bok is an en word, so ett does not fit.
why: Subject + verb + object: Jag + läser + en bok.

distractorWhy: Äpple is an ett word, so en does not fit.
why: Subject + verb + object: Hon + äter + ett äpple.

distractorWhy: After vill the verb stays in the infinitive.
why: Subject + helper + infinitive: Jag + vill + äta.
Yes/no puts the verb first: Har + du + en bil.

distractorWhy: Bo is the infinitive; need bor.
why: Question + verb + subject: Var + bor + du.

distractorWhy: Äta is infinitive; a statement needs äter.
why: Inte goes right after the verb.
Verb stays second: Idag + äter + jag + en smörgås.

distractorWhy: After kan the verb stays infinitive.

why: Question + verb + subject: Vad + läser + du.

prompt: We live here and she reads.
sentence: Vi bor här och hon läser.
